oracle: /connect and /signup are 200 with X-Frame-Options: DENY and frame-ancestors 'none' (A1.9)
what: firebase.json's header rule for /connect names a path nothing requests, so /connect is served without its frame headers while /signup keeps them

target.case: A1.9 /connect and /signup send X-Frame-Options: DENY and Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors 'none'

expect.message: these are not: /connect 200 X-Frame-Options=null frame-ancestors=null; /connect\?\S+ 200 X-Frame-Options=null frame-ancestors=null(?:\n|$)
